UPDATE playback_source_metadata
               SET duration_seconds = $5,
                   duration_status = $6,
                   duration_source = $7,
                   duration_error = NULL,
                   next_retry_at = NULL,
                   version = version + 1
             WHERE room_id = $1
               AND media_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2
               AND playlist_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $3
               AND target_hash = $4
               AND version = $8
